scenario: [LNLS.3.11]: a series membership scan is allowed with `linear_scan: false` when the series declares `capacity: N` ([LSER.13.14]). `contains(t.state, 5)` over a series declared with `capacity: 100` scans at most 100 retained samples -- O(N), bounded by a compile-time constant, exactly as a capacity-bounded string operation is ([LNLS.3.10]). Companion to `LNLS.3.11.json`, the same program without the capacity, which is refused with `DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_SERIES_UNBOUNDED`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.lnls_3_11_series_scan` through `lnls_3_11_bounded`, which requires every `series` declaration of the slot in the file to carry `capacity:`. A typecheck that keyed the bound on anything else -- a `max_samples:` kwarg, or a `sample <n>` line -- refuses this and the vector goes red.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Int mutable

series Sensor.state (by: entity_id, capacity: 100):
    contains sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where contains(t.state, 5)
->
    log info "x"
